question: Related Questions Q. It is necessary to pay the fixed mahr 3684 views Q. Marriage is expected to be performed after 1 month. Primary talks are done happily between two families. Regarding this situation, a local Aleem says: 1. Both the boy and girl can talk to each other over phone in the mean time since their marriage proposal is agreed between two families and a probable time-period is setup to finalize it. 2. It is also the Sunnah of Rasulullah (SAWS) to create a lovely period/situation between boy and girl before marriage. I would like to know, whether the answers given by the Aleem are right according to Islamic Shariah. 4592 views Q. Janab Assalam-mualayikum, Hum ek kafi bade masale me fhase hue hai, Humne apki Nikkad kitab (english version) padhi hai, Usme Line no.18 per jo masala bayan kar rakha hai, usse talluq rakhta hai. Humne wohi masala Shahi-Bukhari me bhi padha. Janab, hum pichle kayee mahino se apni shadi ke talluq se fiqar ghuza the, or dil jaisi koi ladki nazar me nahi aa rahi thi. Tab achanak Humari Phupu ki ladki jo humari hum umr hain kisis tijarati fiqar se humare yahan rehne aayi. Uski aadatein, soch, taur-tariqee dekh kar woh hume pasand aane lagi, usme woh tammam sifatein hain jo hum apne jode me talsh kar rahe they, Hum apni yeh pasand apne walidaein ko pesh karnehi wale they ki Shahi-Bukahri ke supplement per nazar gayi. jo Line no. hum pehle bayan kar rakhe hain. Jo wakiya usme bayan hua hai, hum wahi galti apne umr ki 13 weh saal me kar baithein hai, Hum apne nafz ke hathon kaid ho rakhe thein or raat k waqt humne apni phupu ko galat intension se unke jism ko hath lagaya. Yeh galti 2-3 martaba ho chuki humse Is baat ko ab 13 saal ho chuke hain, Ab bataur Allah Hukum, hum unki ladki se nikaah nahi kar sakte, Per hume woh ladki kafi pasand hai, Kya is galti ki koi iscilah nahi ho sakti, taki hum usse nikah kar sakein. Batur-ehsaan hum guzarish karte hain ke hume jaldi jawab mile, usse kuch ladkewale dekh ne aane wale hai agle budh ko, hum usse pehle apni khwahish apne walidein ke samne rakhna chahte hai. Ap ke jawab ka badi be-sabri se intezar kiya jaye ga. Dua- ke darkhwast Allah Hafiz! 7277 views Q. answer: Social Matters >> Nikah (Marriage) Question ID: 6144 Country: Pakistan Title: If the person who held nikah sermony , knows that , guy is homosexsual and fornikater , while bride is pure virgin muslim girl , then the nikah will be legal or not. Question: If the person who held nikah sermony , knows that , guy is homosexsual and fornikater , while bride is pure virgin muslim girl , then the nikah will be legal or not. Answer ID: 6144 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1169/142=B/1429) If the boy is Muslim then the Nikah shall be valid. But one should not give any virgin and virtuous girl in the Nikah of a fornicator and homosexual knowingly. It is injustice with the girl. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
